en: A vintage black‑and‑white view of a small alpine town square. In the foreground on the right stands a stone fountain in front of a traditional building with shutters and a religious image on its facade. On the left are fenced houses with balconies and a roadside water trough with a pump. In the center background a three‑story building carries the sign 'PANIFICIO COMUNALE'. Rolling hills or low mountains rise beyond the town. Along the bottom margin, printed in red, is the caption 'Romeno - Alta Anaunia - m. 962'.
